title: Forms
description: Collect submissions from the HTML forms on your static site. Each form gets a public endpoint to post to.

create.title: New form
create.description: Pick a short name. It becomes part of the endpoint address and cannot be changed later.
create.name: Form name

empty.title: No forms yet
empty.description: Create a form, design its fields, paste the snippet into your site, and submissions land here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.redirectHint: Browsers are sent here after a post. Leave empty to show a plain thank-you page.
settings.honeypotHint: A hidden field real visitors leave empty. Posts that fill it are kept as spam and never notify you.
settings.noChannels: No notification channels are set up yet. Add one under Alerts to be told about new submissions.

delete.title: Delete this form?
delete.description: The endpoint stops accepting posts right away.
delete.consequence: All stored submissions for this form are deleted and cannot be recovered.

retention: Submissions are deleted after {{days}} days. Only a salted hash of the sender address is stored, never the address.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.emptyDescription: Post to the endpoint above, or send a test from your site, and it appears here.
inbox.noMatchDescription: Try a different search or filter.

betaHint: Beta: form capture works, but its designer and limits are still changing.
intro: Static sites cannot run server code. Forms gives your site a public endpoint that stores submissions.

hero.alt: A visitor fills in a form on your site and presses Send. The submission travels to your Levelrail endpoint, appears in the inbox and triggers a notification.
hero.caption: Design a form, paste it into your static site, and read submissions here.

design.title: Design your form
design.body: Pick the fields, labels and success message.

embed.title: Paste the snippet into your site
embed.body: Copy the HTML or JavaScript into your page.

read.title: Read submissions here
read.body: Get notified when someone sends one.

notStatic.title: Forms are for static sites
notStatic.description: This app runs its own server code, so it can handle form posts itself. Forms collects submissions for apps that deploy as a static site.

design.title: Design
design.help: Choose the fields visitors fill in and what they see after sending.

embed.title: Embed
embed.help: Copy this into your static site. It follows your design as you edit.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.help: Everything visitors send lands here. Export it as CSV any time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Where visitors go afterwards, spam protection and who gets notified.

designer.label: Label
designer.name: Field name
designer.usingDefault: This form uses the default fields: name, email and message. Customize them to design your own.
designer.originsHint: One address per line, like https://example.com. Browsers on other sites are refused. Empty allows any site.

noPublicUrl.title: No public URL is set
noPublicUrl.body: No public URL is set, this endpoint only works from this machine. Visitors to your live site cannot reach it.

variantHint.fetch: HTML with a fetch script (stays on the page)
variantHint.minimal: Minimal markup (no labels, bring your own styling)

test.ok: It is marked as a test in the inbox below.
